Users should configure mobile push or phone calls as notifications.

title: Grafana Cloud k6 – Brief metrics unavailability

updates.body: A transient issue prevented Grafana Cloud k6 from serving metrics to a small number of customers for approximately 3–4 minutes. The issue has been resolved, and normal service has been restored.

title: Degraded Performance with Increased Latency for Grafana Cloud Metrics and Traces in GCP US Central

updates.body: Beginning around 10:20 UTC, we have been seeing intermittent elevated error rates and latency affecting Grafana Cloud Metrics and Logs in GCP US Central (prod-us-central-0 and prod-us-central-5), and periodic increased latency and occasional errors affecting Grafana Cloud Traces in prod-us-central-0. Customers may see errors or delays when sending metrics, logs and traces. We are actively investigating. Next update by 13:40 UTC.

We continue to investigate intermittent elevated error rates and latency affecting Grafana Cloud Metrics and Logs in GCP US Central (prod-us-central-0 and prod-us-central-5), and periodic increased latency affecting Grafana Cloud Traces in prod-us-central-0.
